raw_response: The figure presents a line graph illustrating the percentage of immigrants born abroad residing in Germany over time, segmented by age groups. The x-axis represents age in years, ranging from 20 to 75, with tick intervals of 5 years. The y-axis displays the percentage, ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick intervals of 10%. The graph includes three data series: a black line representing the percentage of immigrants born abroad without migration background, a light gray line representing the percentage of immigrants born in Germany, and a blue line representing the percentage of immigrants who have migrated to Germany before 2010. At the beginning of the x-axis (age 20), the black line is approximately 82%, the light gray line is approximately 12%, and the blue line is approximately 1%. At the end of the x-axis (age 70), the black line is approximately 28%, the light gray line is approximately 18%, and the blue line is approximately 3%. All three lines exhibit fluctuating patterns, with the black line generally maintaining a higher percentage than the other two, while the blue line shows a significant decline from its initial value.
